def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Top triplet are rays: outer colors project to matching side markers; middle color spans full column.
    tops=[(c,grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if grid[0][c]]
    if len(tops)<3: return out
    (c1,a),(cm,b),(c3,c)=tops[:3]
    left=next(((r,x) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for x,v in enumerate(row) if v==a and r>0 and x==0),None)
    right=next(((r,x) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for x,v in enumerate(row) if v==c and r>0 and x==w-1),None)
    for r in range(1,h):
        if left is None or r<=left[0]: out[r][c1]=a
        else: break
    if left:
        r,_=left
        for x in range(w): out[r][x]=a
    for r in range(1,h): out[r][cm]=b
    for r in range(1,h):
        if right is None or r<=right[0]: out[r][c3]=c
        else: break
    if right:
        r,_=right
        for x in range(w): out[r][x]=c
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    seeds=[(c,v) for c,v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v]
    for c,v in seeds:
        markers=[(r,x) for r in range(1,h) for x in range(w) if grid[r][x]==v]
        # If a matching marker exists, connect its row to the seed; otherwise extend the seed down to the bottom.
        target=markers[0][0] if markers else h-1
        for r in range(1,target+1):
            if out[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=v
        if markers:
            r,x=markers[0]
            lo,hi=sorted((c,x))
            for j in range(lo,hi+1):
                if out[r][j]==0: out[r][j]=v
    return out
PY
